description.value:
Requirement Access to a proper workshop.

Check Crafting against a DC set by the GM

Permanently raise one firearm by a single rarity step, narrowing its Failure Range accordingly — a Scrap Gun becomes a Pipe Gun, a Pipe Gun becomes Good-Made. On a failure the week is spent and the weapon is unchanged; on a critical failure the weapon is also destroyed. This can never carry a weapon past Good-Made: the step from there to Turning Good is something a gun does in your hands over time, not something a workshop does to it.

cinderfall.incomplete: no selector for skill-check-gated item-rarity change (same reasoning as field-conversion/jury-rig-repair).
